slides.title: Design for someone else
slides.text: Today you are the designer. Real teams plan, build, test with someone else, improve the work and document it.
slides.alt: Pro Level Maker task 1 of 3: the goal is walled in. Open walls so Bolt can reach it, then press Check.

focus.cue: Task 1 of 3: open the walls so Bolt can reach the goal
Check proves it can be solved

slides.title: Keep a timeline
slides.text: Split the work and set times: build by minute 6, test by 12, fix by 18. Write who does each part. The game's three maker tasks are your first checkpoints.
slides.alt: Task 2 of 3: too easy, par is 1. Move the goal or add walls until par is at least 10, and keep it solvable.

focus.cue: Task 2 of 3: make par at least 10
Checkpoint: press Check when it is done

slides.title: Feedback is information
slides.text: Feedback is not a grade. It shows where a player got stuck. A level is done when that feedback changed something and you tested it again.
slides.alt: After a friend tests the level, the tester card asks for one fun thing and one confusing thing, with nothing to type.

focus.cue: One fun thing the tester noticed
Change one thing, then Check again

slides.title: Iterate
slides.text: Going round this loop is called iteration. Check proves the level can be solved and shows its par.
slides.alt: A Pro level with a gem, a key and a door on the way to the goal, and Check says it can be solved: par 23.

focus.cue: Test it with someone, then change and test again

slides.title: Write the level note
slides.text: A good note helps the next person play or remix it, like: Level 2: count the gems before the door. The game saves your level and its code, so write the note on paper with the code at the top. Remixed levels keep their based-on stamp.
slides.alt: A level worth a note: three gems on the way to the door, a key to fetch first, and Check says it can be solved.

focus.cue: The note names the tricky part: three gems
And the key that opens the door

words.means: one more round of build, test and improve
what testers tell you about where they got stuck
notes that explain your work to the next person

slides.title: Bolt's piece lights up
slides.text: Bolt's piece of the Spark lights up: the first of four. His roads run, his bugs are fixed and his levels are built. The next world belongs to Dot the fox, who follows clues the way you follow code.

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Level Maker and do the three maker tasks to finish this step. Then, as a stretch, build your own level from a plan, let someone test it in silence, and change one thing. Write its level note on paper, with the level code at the top.
slides.alt: Pro Level Maker task 1 of 3: the goal is walled in. Open walls so Bolt can reach it, then press Check.

focus.cue: Three maker tasks, one after another
